newsitem.title: NIGERIA: 30 students perish in Nigerian road crash.
newsitem.headline: 30 students perish in Nigerian road crash.

text.p: Thirty students died when their bus collided with an articulated lorry in northern Nigeria, the News Agency of Nigeria reported on Monday.
It said the accident occurred last Thursday along the Damaturu-Potiskum road in the northeast.
The students, from two colleges in Potiskum town, were on their way home to celebrate the end of the Moslem Ramadan fast, the agency said.
